summary: This downtown metal-plating shop near the Milwaukee River released about 10,200 lb to the air in 2024, mostly the solvent 1-bromopropane, and sent about 29,100 lb of nitrates to the city sewer plant.

impacts.title: Air & breathing
impacts.where: Downtown and the Haymarket area, within 1 mile: 32,562 residents, 20 schools
impacts.how: About 8,700 lb of 1-bromopropane, a degreasing solvent, escaped into the air in 2024, plus about 1,200 lb of nitric acid and small amounts of cyanide, nickel and lead. Nitric acid irritates the eyes, nose and lungs.

avoid.label: Check air quality
avoid.text: Check the daily air quality index (AirNow) for Milwaukee

avoid.label: Report odors
avoid.text: Report strong or unusual odors in the forum, where the company can reply. You can also call the DNR tip line, 1-800-847-9367

avoid.label: Close the windows
avoid.text: Keep windows closed when odors are noticeable

impacts.title: Long-term health
impacts.how: EPA added 1-bromopropane to its list of hazardous air pollutants in 2022, and TRI flags it as a carcinogen. Long-term exposure can also harm the nervous system. The shop has cut its releases from about 19,100 lb in 2022 to about 8,700 lb in 2024. Nickel compounds, also released here, are carcinogens too.

avoid.label: Follow the changes
avoid.text: Follow EPA's rules on 1-bromopropane as they are finalized

avoid.label: Comment on permits
avoid.text: Comment when the shop's air permit comes up for renewal

avoid.label: Ask for air monitoring
avoid.text: Ask local officials about air monitoring near schools

impacts.title: Sewer & Lake Michigan
impacts.where: Milwaukee's wastewater plant, then Lake Michigan
impacts.how: The shop sent about 29,100 lb of nitrates down the sewer in 2024, plus small amounts of nickel, copper, lead and cyanide. The Milwaukee Metropolitan Sewerage District treats this before its water reaches Lake Michigan. Which of its two plants receives it still needs to be confirmed.

avoid.label: Check the beach
avoid.text: Check beach advisories before swimming at Bradford or McKinley Beach

avoid.label: No swims after rain
avoid.text: Stay out of the lake after heavy rain, when sewers can overflow

avoid.label: Ask about the sewer
avoid.text: Ask MMSD about its industrial pretreatment program

impacts.title: Schools nearby
impacts.how: More schools sit within a mile of this shop than any other factory on this map, including Golda Meir School, Roosevelt Middle and Lincoln Middle. Children breathe more air for their size, so nearby air pollution matters more for them.

avoid.label: Kids play indoors
avoid.text: Keep kids indoors during air quality alerts

avoid.label: Ask your school
avoid.text: Ask your school whether it tracks local air quality

avoid.label: Join neighbors
avoid.text: Join neighborhood groups that follow local permits
